judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving two of its own facets unchecked and committing `.lore/dod.md` to the repository. While the core `ajv` validation and caching logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` works (and uses `import Ajv from 'ajv'` which may fail ESM typechecking without `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`), `execute` unnecessarily invokes `this.resolveDefinition` even for static tools and omits both the warning log on validation failure and the required one-line JSDoc comment. Most of the acceptance criteria are missing: `registry.test.ts` only contains a single test instead of the required suite (instead putting four tests in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts`), `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` was not updated at all, and several spec statements lack `[validated by ...]` links. Furthermore, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and `CHANGELOG.md` only mentions `register` rather than `execute` validation and the migration note.
